 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Greece will host Serbia at Panthessaliko Stadium in Volos, Greece, for the final matchday of the UEFA Nations League group stage in Group A2.
 Greece have a chance to reach the quarterfinals of the UEFA Nations League if they beat Serbia. Greece is second in the group with 8 points, while Serbia is bottom of the group with 0 points.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Greece are tied on points with Germany in the group, but Greece is second due to the head-to-head record. Greece defeated Germany 1-0 away from home and then drew 0-0 with Germany at home. Greece only needs to beat Serbia to qualify for the quarterfinals, regardless of whether Germany beats the Netherlands.
 In the previous matchday, Greece suffered a 7-0 loss to the Netherlands while Serbia lost 3-1 to Germany at home.
 UEFA Photo / Getty Images

 Where to Watch Greece vs. Serbia – UEFA Nations League – League A Group 2 
 Greece vs. Serbia kicks off at 2:45 P.M. ET / 11:45 A.M. PT in the United States. The match will kick off at 9:45 P.M. local time at Panthessaliko Stadium in Volos, Greece.
 The match will be available to watch in the United States and in other countries through select TV channels and streaming services.
